name: GraphQL
notes: schema plus query; the resolver returns "Hello World"

test.run: cd /tmp && npm install -s graphql@16.9.0 && node -e 'const g=require("graphql");const d=g.parse(require("fs").readFileSync("/src/HelloWorld.graphql","utf8"));const ex=d.definitions.filter(g.isExecutableDefinitionNode);const s=g.buildASTSchema({kind:"Document",definitions:d.definitions.filter(x=>!ex.includes(x))});const e=g.validate(s,{kind:"Document",definitions:ex});if(e.length){console.error(e.join("\n"));process.exit(1)}'
